newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Steel says to shut down hot-rolling line.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Steel says to shut down hot-rolling line.

text.p: Nippon Steel Corp said on Monday that the hot-rolling line at its Oita plant, in western Japan, will likely be shut down for the next two months as a result of a fire there early last week.
The company said it would be able to continue to supply hot-rolled steel sheets and coils to its customers from other plants.
However, the company said it had also asked other steel mills to help supply five tonnes of steel products to meet the immediate needs of its customers.
